log_scalar_metric_with_run: log a scalar metric using _run.log_scalar with a named metric, value, and step number
log_scalar_metric_with_experiment: log a scalar metric using ex.log_scalar with a named metric, value, and step number
log_scalar_metric_implicit_step: log a scalar metric using ex.log_scalar with an auto-incrementing implicit step number
log_multiple_scalar_metrics: log multiple named scalar metrics per step using ex.log_scalar for training loss and accuracy
linearize_metrics: linearize a list of ScalarMetricLogEntry objects into a dict grouped by metric name with steps and values
